findings.claim: The workflow will fail at `npm ci` because the repository shape in this packet does not include the package manifest/lockfile that `npm ci` requires.
findings.evidence: The workflow adds `- run: npm ci` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, while the provided `file_tree` lists no `package.json` or `package-lock.json` at the repository root; the plan also states `ci-three-os` depends on `project-scaffold`, which is where those files are supposed to be created.
findings.suggested_fix: Land/include the `project-scaffold` files (`package.json` and `package-lock.json`) before or with this workflow, or do not mark this CI change complete until that dependency exists in the repo.
